The new route splits the square into the four center-to-vertex right triangles with legs r and r: 4 × (r²/2) = 2r² = 100, so r² = 50 and the area is 50π, without ever finding r. Choice A now also names the forgot-the-½ path (4r² = 100 gives 25π); choice D now describes diagonal-as-radius as (2r)² = 4 × 50 = 200, with no radical. No field mentions the Pythagorean theorem, the distance formula or a square root. Stem, tags, all four answer values, choice IDs and key B = 50π unchanged. Needs the scope reviewer's sign-off on the area-decomposition demand.
